summary: Langlade County, WI lookout moved from a 1934 site to Basswood Hill; a 1940 station record gives its design; now listed as gone, with no removal date found.

facts.design: Standard 100-foot U.S. Forest Service lookout tower of structural steel with an enclosed observation platform
facts.status_note: Listed as gone; the 1940 station record says it had already been moved from its 1934 site

events.note: The tower stood at another site in 1934, according to a later station record
The 1940 station description says the tower had already been moved from its 1934 site and stood on Basswood Hill; the move itself is not dated, so 1940 is the first year it is recorded there

evidence.supports: about 17 miles north-northwest of Antigo, in Langlade County
evidence.quote: STATION IS LOCATED ABOUT 17 MILES NORTH-NORTHWEST OF ANTIGO,

evidence.supports: the survey station stands on a low wooded hill
the Forest Service described the station in 1940
the record is a National Geodetic Survey station record

evidence.quote: A STANDARD 100-FOOT U.S. FOREST SERVICE LOOKOUT TOWER MADE OF

evidence.supports: structural steel with an enclosed observation platform at the top
evidence.quote: STRUCTURAL STEEL WITH AN ENCLOSED OBSERVATION PLATFORM AT ITS

evidence.supports: the tower had already been moved
evidence.quote: THE LOOKOUT TOWER HAS BEEN MOVED

evidence.supports: moved from the site it occupied in 1934
evidence.quote: FROM THE SITE IT OCCUPIED IN 1934.

evidence.supports: the Wisconsin Department of Conservation is the agency
evidence.quote: Langlade County - Wisconsin Department of Conservation

evidence.supports: the county list marks the tower as gone

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, staffing, fire or removal date appears in the sources read. The design and the 1934 move come from a reproduced National Geodetic Survey record, so they are firm; the rest is thin. The Langlade County Historical Society and Antigo Times Facebook posts about the lookout network could not be read (login wall). Used two WebSearch calls and about five page reads for this tower.
